import numpy as np
d=np.load("showcase.npz")
X,y,classes=d["X"],d["y"],d["classes"]
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
tr,te=train_test_split(np.arange(len(X)),test_size=.25,random_state=42,stratify=y)
means=np.stack([X[tr][y[tr]==c].mean(axis=0) for c in range(4)])
dist=((X[te,None].astype(float)-means[None])**2).sum(axis=(2,3))
centroid_acc=round(float((dist.argmin(axis=1)==y[te]).mean()),3)
fig,axs=plt.subplots(1,4)
for c,ax in enumerate(axs):
    ax.imshow(means[c],cmap="gray",vmin=0,vmax=255); ax.set_title(classes[c])
print(centroid_acc)
expect: means (4,32,32), accuracy по 500 тестовым кадрам 0..1; четыре средние картинки.
